# Bharat Enterprise

> Bharat Enterprise is a GST-ready billing, inventory, customer ledger, and SaaS management platform designed for distributors, medical stores, and small-to-medium businesses.

## Overview
- [Product Overview](%DOMAIN%/docs/overview.md): Product purpose, target users, and major capabilities.
- [Architecture](%DOMAIN%/docs/architecture.md): High-level application architecture and data flow.
- [Landing Page (Markdown)](%DOMAIN%/landing.md): Complete product feature showcase and marketing summary in Markdown.

## Billing & Finance
- [GST Billing](%DOMAIN%/docs/gst-billing.md): Invoice creation, GST calculation, tax handling, and invoice lifecycle.
- [Customer Khata](%DOMAIN%/docs/customer-khata.md): Customer balances, credit, payments, and ledger history.
- [Payments](%DOMAIN%/docs/payments.md): Payment recording and settlement workflows.

## Inventory
- [Inventory Management](%DOMAIN%/docs/inventory.md): Product stock management, immutable movement ledger, and inventory adjustments.

## SaaS & Commercials
- [SaaS Multi-Tenancy](%DOMAIN%/docs/subscriptions.md): Multi-tenant architecture, tenant lifecycle, and write-access gating.
- [Pricing & Plans](%DOMAIN%/docs/pricing.md): Subscription plans, capabilities, and account lifecycle.
